intro_text: Getting from Bordeaux Airport (Mérignac) to the main train station is straightforward. You have two main options:

questions.question: 1. What is it?
questions.tram: Direct tram connection from Bordeaux Airport (Mérignac) to Gare Saint-Jean (main train station). Launched Dec 6, 2025.
questions.shuttle: Direct coach shuttle from Bordeaux Airport to Gare Saint-Jean. No intermediate stops, no transfers.

questions.question: 2. How frequently does it run?
questions.tram: Every 10 min (Mon–Sat) / Every 15 min (Sun/holidays). First: ~5am. Last: Midnight (Mon–Wed), 1am (Thu–Sat)
questions.shuttle: Limited: 07:30–20:05 daily. Mon–Fri: ~22 runs. Sat/Sun: ~14 runs. Not available early morning or late evening.

questions.question: 5. What about my bike?!?!
questions.tram:
✅ Bikes in cases: Always
✅ Bikes not in cases: 9am–4pm only
❌ NOT 7am–9am or 4pm–7pm
Pack in case to avoid rush hours.
TBM Bicycle Rules: 05 57 57 88 88
questions.shuttle:
✅ Bikes in cases: Yes
✅ Bikes not in cases: Yes
Requirement: Closed bag, labeled with name, phone, address.
Carrier may refuse oversized items.
Bikes not in cases = anytime transport (no restrictions).
30'Direct FAQ: 30direct.com

questions.question: 6. How do I book?
questions.tram:
No booking required. Buy ticket at tram stop (vending machine), TBM mobile app (Bordeaux transit app), or Relay newsstand at airport.

To board: Validate your ticket on the platform or onboard validators (card readers, white validators, or TBM app via Bluetooth). Self-validate and board—no ticket inspection.
questions.shuttle:
Book online at 30direct.com or pay €10 on board. Book in advance for €9 rate.

To board: Show your ticket to the driver (printed, phone e-ticket, or mobile). Tickets can be purchased directly from the driver. Visa/Mastercard accepted onboard (American Express not accepted).
